description:
Construct an interactive demonstration of Viviani's Theorem in GeoGebra. 

1. Create an equilateral triangle with base vertices at A=(0,0) and B=(6,0). The third vertex C should be at approximately (3, 5.2).
2. Create a free, draggable point P inside the triangle.
3. Measure the perpendicular distances from P to all three sides of the triangle.
4. Add a text annotation to the view that displays the sum of these three distances. 

Save the completed construction as 'viviani_theorem.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
